open_points.subject: AdmissionVerdict identity and repeated admission
open_points.text: “Substitution: a verdict for the same implementation and corpus is the same verdict.” / “every active case of the corpus is run again for the implementation at admission time, and the verdict covers exactly those executions.”
open_points.question: When the same implementation is submitted again against the unchanged corpus, is the existing AdmissionVerdict and its original TrialExecutions reused, or is a new verdict created for the newly minted TrialExecutions?
options: Reuse the existing verdict and executions
Run new TrialExecutions but keep one semantic verdict
Create a new distinct verdict for each admission run
open_points.default_guess: Reuse the existing verdict and executions for the unchanged implementation and corpus.

open_points.subject: ProofResult identity
open_points.text: “Substitution: proving the same version gives the same result.” / “whether a flow version whose proof failed because a binding was not yet accepted can be proven again later — closed by A05 (yes).”
open_points.question: Is ProofResult identified only by the immutable flow version, or can the same flow version have different ProofResults as referenced bindings move from proposed to accepted?
options: One immutable result per flow version
A distinct result for each proof evaluation and relevant binding state
A latest mutable result per flow version
open_points.default_guess: Treat each proof evaluation's result as a value that may differ when binding state changes.

open_points.subject: Read-only flow activation action
open_points.text: “activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once” / “the kernel exposes ... the owner's approve, accept, activate, grant, revoke, resolve and cancel.”
open_points.question: May an agent request activation of a proven read-only flow, or is every activation request owner-only?
options: Owner or agent may request read-only activation; effectful activation is owner-only
open_points.default_guess: Allow an owner or agent to request read-only activation, following K-08 and the primary action table.

open_points.subject: Requester of automatic read-only activation
open_points.text: “the owner's actions, each agent's and the kernel's own are distinguishable in every record” / “activated_by ... `kernel` for ... the activation of a proven read-only flow”
open_points.question: Where is the owner or agent who requested an automatic read-only FlowActivation recorded, given that FlowActivation records the kernel as `activated_by` and no activation-request model is defined?
options: Add the requester as a FlowActivation fact
Do not retain the requester; record only the kernel
open_points.default_guess: Add a requester fact while retaining `kernel` as the actor that performed the activation.

open_points.subject: Run cancellation or refusal during active work
open_points.text: “cancel a run | owner | the run ends `cancelled`; nothing further is sent | a finished run cannot be cancelled” / “When the owner refuses an effect, the run ends `refused`.”
open_points.question: Can cancellation or refusal occur while another node or effect attempt is actively executing, and if so, what lifecycle and NodeExecution or EffectAttempt status applies to that already-started work after the run has ended?
options: Actions are possible only while the run is quiescent at waiting points
Already-started work is aborted and receives a defined terminal status
Already-started work may finish and be recorded after the run becomes cancelled or refused
open_points.default_guess: Permit these actions only while the run is resting at waiting points, so no other work is in flight.

open_points.subject: EffectApproval preview persistence
open_points.text: “`preview`: what the owner saw — operation, target service, the built request and the input values” / “Secrets ... never enter ... a trace or an answer.” / “A file moves between nodes through a spool that belongs to its run and is emptied when the run ends”
open_points.question: What exactly is durably stored in an EffectApproval preview for credential-bearing headers, personal-data values, and file request bodies, especially after the run's spool is removed?
options: Store complete request and input payloads except credential values
Store bounded values inline and file or secret references/digests only
Store only the request digest and a separately generated non-durable presentation
open_points.default_guess: Store a durable structured preview with bounded values inline, file references and digests instead of file bytes, and no credential values.
